provenance.brief: Name a film directed by Sukumar.

quotes.Arya: He made his directorial debut with Arya (2004), which was a major success
quotes.Jagadam: Unlike Arya, Jagadam focused more on violence and in an interview with South Scope, Sukumar called the film an "act of bravado", adding that he "made it with an innocent passion", without thinking about the audience's response.
quotes.Arya 2: He then wrote and directed Arya 2 (2009), which was promoted as the namesake sequel to his debut Arya.
quotes.100% Love: After a gap of two years, Sukumar's next directorial film 100% Love (2011) was released.
quotes.1: Nenokkadine: Sangeetha Devi Dundoo of The Hindu stated, "Habitual to watching films that begin with a great premise only to fall into the commercial trap of force-fit comic situations, it comes as a relief when Sukumar laces the psychological thriller with subtle wit that never takes the focus away from the plot".
quotes.I Am That Change: In 2014, he wrote and directed a 3-minute short film I Am That Change produced by and starring Allu Arjun.
quotes.Nannaku Prematho: Following the demise of his father Tirupathi Naidu, Sukumar decided to direct Nannaku Prematho starring N. T. Rama Rao Jr. and Rakul Preet Singh in the lead roles.
quotes.Rangasthalam: His 2018 period action film with Ram Charan titled Rangasthalam received positive reviews with particular praise for Ram Charan's performance, and Sukumar's direction and screenplay.
